kvkk.title: General Privacy Notice Regarding the Processing of Personal Data
kvkk.intro: we attach great importance to ensuring the security of your personal data. In this context, we take all necessary technical and administrative measures in accordance with the Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 ("KVKK Law").
kvkk.section1Title: 1. Obtaining, Processing and Purposes of Your Personal Data
kvkk.section1Text: Your personal data is processed for purposes such as conducting company activities, fulfilling legal requirements, security, marketing, customer relations, and meeting legal obligations.
kvkk.identityInfoDesc: Information from documents such as ID cards, passports
kvkk.customerInfoDesc: Information obtained within the scope of commercial relations
kvkk.transactionSecurityInfoDesc: Technical data for conducting commercial activities
kvkk.riskManagementInfoDesc: Data for managing commercial and administrative risks
kvkk.financialInfoDesc: All types of financial information, documents and records
kvkk.section2Text: Your personal data may be shared with company affiliates, business partners, suppliers, public institutions and authorized private individuals in accordance with Articles 8 and 9 of the KVKK Law for the purposes stated above.
kvkk.section3Text: Data is deleted, destroyed or anonymized in accordance with Article 7 of the KVKK Law at the end of the periods determined by legislation or required by the nature of the work.
kvkk.section4Title: 4. Your Rights Regarding the Processing of Personal Data
kvkk.section4Text: As a personal data owner, you have the following rights under Article 11 of the KVKK Law:
kvkk.right1: Learning whether your data is being processed
kvkk.right2: Requesting information if it has been processed
kvkk.right4: Requesting correction of incomplete or incorrect data
kvkk.right5: Requesting deletion or destruction of data
kvkk.right6: Requesting notification to transferred third parties
kvkk.right7: Objecting to results of automated analysis
kvkk.right8: Requesting compensation for damages due to unlawful processing
kvkk.section5Text: To exercise your rights above, you can apply using the "Personal Data Protection Application Form" through one of the following methods:
kvkk.applicationMethod1: Hand delivery to Yunus Emre Mah. Lütfi Aykaç Blv. No:80 Sultangazi/İstanbul
kvkk.responseTime: A response will be given within 30 days at the latest from the date the request reaches our company. Additional information may be requested from the applicant if necessary. Also, if the response incurs costs, the fee determined by the KVKK Board may be charged.
kvkk.moreInfo: For detailed information, please contact us.

fiveBox.popup1Title: The Easiest Way to Buy a Home: It Starts at NATA Living!
fiveBox.popup1Text: Reaching your dream home is no longer a difficult process. NATA Living transforms the home searching experience from start to finish with its digital platforms and user-friendly interface. Whether you search with smart filters or explore by location, you can find the most suitable project for you in seconds.
fiveBox.popup2Title: Simplify Your Life with Smart Technology-Equipped Living Spaces!
fiveBox.popup2Text:
To keep up with today's fast pace, you need not just a beautiful home, but a living space that offers functional and technological solutions. NATA Living projects save you time and improve your quality of life with remotely controllable smart systems, energy efficiency, social facilities, and central locations.

• Smart home systems
• Secure and sustainable infrastructure
• Modern architectural designs
fiveBox.popup3Title: The New Definition of Modern Living: Get Ready for the Future with NATA Living!
fiveBox.popup3Text: Today, the need for living spaces that offer comfort, aesthetics, and technology together is increasing every day. NATA Living projects make modern life possible not only by meeting housing needs but also with security, sustainability, and smart living solutions. From energy-saving systems to facilities supporting social life, these projects are designed with every detail in mind, making transportation easier with their central locations while saving you time and improving your quality of life.
fiveBox.popup4Title: The New Definition of Living in Ankara: Prestige, Comfort and Value!
fiveBox.popup4Text:
In Ankara's rising districts, NATA Living projects shaped with visionary architecture promise long-term gains for investors and a privileged life for residents. Just minutes from the city center, we make luxury accessible with different alternatives from apartments with spacious balconies to panoramic residences.

• Panoramic city view
• Internationally awarded projects
• Prestigious living spaces
fiveBox.popup5Title: Our Dreams Are Shared: This Jersey Is All of Our Hope!
fiveBox.popup5Text:
The symbol of a big dream that started in a small child's room: The crescent and star jersey. As Nata Holding, we believe in the unifying power of sports and we share in children's dreams. While supporting our National Team, we also inspire the stars of the future.
